title: I turned a $80 RK3562 Android tablet into a Debian Linux workstation
summary: A developer converted an inexpensive $80 RK3562 Android tablet into a fully functional Debian Linux workstation, demonstrating how to repurpose cheap consumer hardware for desktop computing by installing Linux and enabling peripherals like keyboard/mouse.
problem_solved: Transforms low-cost, low-power Android tablets into productive Linux workstations, reducing e-waste and providing affordable computing access.
why_valuable: Shows that capable Linux workstations can be built from sub-$100 hardware, making computing more accessible and promoting hardware hacking/open-source philosophy.
